entries.canonical_text: この記事では、AIが島で見つけたことを記録に残し、その記録が後の作業にどう関わるかが紹介されました。ただし、この実験だけで、遊び自体が役立つと証明されたわけではありません。最後に、記事の要点を英語で振り返ります。

entries.canonical_text: The AI agents sent to the island had no set tasks or rewards. But their starting settings led them to be curious, explore, and learn. They had no homework, but they were ready to explore.

entries.canonical_text: Even so, it is too soon to wave a flag and say, Play and get smarter—proof complete! The experienced group did better, and removing one memory lowered its score. These 2 results need to be studied separately. By themselves, they do not show that play itself made a difference.
